title: Àjà Obi Dị n'Ime Uche
intro: N'oge ule Chineke, a kpọrọ mkpụrụ obi ka o mee ihe kachasị mkpa nke ido onwe ya n'okpuru. Mgbe a zụlitere ya n'ala kpọrọ nkụ, onye a toro wee gosipụta okwukwe na ndidi. Mgbe ọhụụ nyere iwu ka a chụọ àjà, ha emeghị obi abụọ. Akụkọ ha bụ ntọala nke nraranye.
clues: Abụ m azịza nye ekpere onye amụma ukwu a na-atụ anya ya kemgbe.
Mụ na mama m hapụrụ n'ime ndagwurugwu tọgbọrọ chakoo, naanị ihe oriri mkpụrụ osisi na mmiri dị na ya.
E tolitere m ịghọ onye amụma a maara maka eziokwu na ndidi m.
Enyere m nna m aka iwuli ntọala nke ụlọ nsọ e raara nye Allah.
Mgbe nna m gwara m nrọ m ga-eji chụọ m àjà, m zara, sị, 'Mee ihe e nyere gị iwu.'
Allah kwanyeere m ùgwù site n'izite ebule site n'eluigwe ka ọ gbapụta m.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: N'ịrara onwe gị nye ka e wee chụọ gị àjà
Ịbụ onye azụ̀ dị egwu loro
Ịbụ onye e rere n'ịbụ ohu
Ịnwale ya na ọrịa siri ike
trial.answer: N'ịrara onwe gị nye ka e wee chụọ gị àjà

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E ji nnukwu ebule gbapụta ya
A zọpụtara ya na idei mmiri
E nyere ya alaeze na amamihe
outcome.answer: E ji nnukwu ebule gbapụta ya

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
